name: Changli

tierList.prydwen: T2 Tower of Adversity, T3 Whimpering Wastes (Hybrid/Dual-DPS)

kit.intro: 5-star Fusion Sword Hybrid, mid-air focused, defined by extreme Quickswap synergy - nearly every key ability (Basic P4, Skill, True Sight: Conquest, Forte Heavy) can be Swap Cancelled to keep her attacking off-field while playing another character. Forte 'Enflamement' (max 4 stacks, from Ultimate or True Sight attacks) unlocks Forte Heavy 'Flaming Sacrifice' nuke.

skills.normalAttack: Blazing Enlightment - 4-hit chain; entering True Sight state (12s) after Basic/Mid-air Attack 4.
skills.resonanceSkill: Tripartite Flames - True Sight: Capture (2 charges), dash attack that also grants True Sight.
skills.forte: Flaming Sacrifice - Heavy Attack consuming 4 Enflamement stacks for a big Resonance-Skill-type nuke with 40% damage reduction during cast.
skills.liberation: Radiance of Fealty - Fusion DMG AoE, grants 4 Enflamement + Fiery Feather (next Forte Heavy gets +25% ATK).
skills.intro: Obedience of Rules - mid-air Fusion DMG, grants True Sight.
skills.outro: Strategy of Duality - next character gains 20% Fusion DMG + 25% Liberation DMG Amplify for 10s (shortest Outro duration in the game alongside Lumi).

echoSet: Molten Rift (5pc, ramping Fusion DMG after Resonance Skill)

teams.name: Best Team (Mono Fusion)
teams.notes: Lupa is the premier Mono Fusion buffer; Brant is the easier partner, Aemeath needs quickswap skill to benefit from Changli's short Outro.

teams.name: Expert Dual-DPS Teams
teams.notes: Extremely high-skill-ceiling quickswap pairs; not recommended for casual players.

teams.name: Budget Dual DPS
teams.notes: Chixia is currently the only character that fully exploits Changli's Outro (20% Fusion + 25% Liberation Amp).

rotation: Opener: Ultimate -> Forte Heavy (swap). Standard: Intro -> True Sight: Charge -> Skill -> Heavy -> True Sight: Charge -> Mid-air Attack -> True Sight: Charge -> Skill -> True Sight: Conquest -> Forte Heavy -> Ultimate -> Forte Heavy (swap) -> Outro. Advanced play swap-cancels nearly every key attack for a Dual-DPS quickswap playstyle.
communityNotes: Prydwen: strong, F2P-weapon-friendly Hybrid whose value is almost entirely defined by her unmatched Quickswap/Swap-Cancel affinity - largely outclassed by more modern Fusion options (Brant, Aemeath) in raw buffing when played passively, but among the best Dual-DPS partners in the game (with Xiangli Yao, Jinhsi, Cartethyia) for expert players willing to learn her swap-cancel-heavy rotation.
